# zirbel-net types

A copy of zirbel's `packages/net/src` (matapao/zirbel, commit a658684: with the revisions, `net.revision`, the `revision` event and `net.data()`), only so `tsc` can check the calls. MIT, see LICENSE. The game imports `/zirbel-net.js` from whatever host serves it; this copy is never bundled. Refresh it when zirbel-net changes.
